title: WASP: Wave Spectra Partitioning
description: Tools for partitioning and matching ocean-wave spectra from models (WaveWatch III) and observations (Sentinel-1 SAR, CFOSAT SWIM, NDBC buoys). Implements Hanson & Phillips (2001) watershed partitioning, secondary-peak reassessment, and descriptor-based partition matching.
references: Hanson, J. L., & Phillips, O. M. (2001). Automated analysis of ocean surface directional wave spectra. Journal of Atmospheric and Oceanic Technology, 18(2), 277-293.
